change: Make CPU-feature initializer checking and vector emission use the same mode predicate. The initial default vectorization increment reserved __cpu_avx2 without checking its initializer, leaving it false and always using SSE2.
validation: 392 numeric/parallel/check/editor/native-test checks passed in 29.84s after independent three-generation C bootstrap. New initializer check passes in default/release and fails as intended on the previous default compiler. Earlier 293 focused checks passed in 13.02s.
decision: Keep the CPU initializer fix: default single-thread matrix time falls by about 47%, and default/release both take about 1.14x serial C time for this workload. Additional loop-invariant motion and priority register allocation were tried and reverted; neither established a useful benefit.
limits: Seven alternating paired matrix and compilation samples. Two-thread wall time was noisy; primary result uses single-thread pairs. C flags/input/checksum method remain those of benchmark_matrix.py.
Tour/game compilation CPU ratios were about 1.00, compiler self-build about 1.018. No compilation speedup claim.

The initial ab5bc8da result correctly demonstrated SSE2 vectorization; its normal default run did not exercise AVX2. With this fix, normal and forced-SSE2 regression executions cover the wider and fallback routes on this AVX2 machine.
Short render validation retained matching Forest/Dunes PNG hashes; no rendering speed claim. The matching frames were visually inspected in the previous paired run.
Hosted CI supplies the full gate; the previous bounded-vector revision passed 4933 checks locally and in CI.
